overview: This table holds the numbers the game uses to work out PvE battle rewards, risk, healing, and extra-mission points.
description: Named scalar constants and multipliers used by the reconstructed PvE result path for risk, money, experience, extra-mission points, heal points and whole-run mode-clear bonuses.

Id.simple: The name the game uses to match this number with the right PvE result, such as mission risk, money, experience, healing, or extra-mission points.
Id.technical: Native FName declared with UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, EditAnywhere, meta=(AllowPrivateAccess=true)) at header line 11; no constructor assignment, so an unset value is the default FName/NAME_None. The export's ImportKeyField is Id but serializes each key as uppercase "ID". No C++ consumer reads the member as data: DataTable lookups use the row key. Consumers construct literal names (RISK_VALUE_*, MONEY_*, EXPERIENCE_*, HEAL_POINT_*, EXTRA_MISSION_POINT_* and mode-clear bonus names) or copy Id_PvECalculation_RiskValue/Money/Experience from a PvEMission row. The five RISK_VALUE_MISSION_DIFFICULTY_* names are reached only through those PvEMission references, not as literals in consumer code. Every lookup goes through StoryFindRowOutOfLine<FGameDataTableRow_PvECalculation>(PvECalculationDataTables, Id, false, false) at 0x1625810: it walks the cached non-null tables in order and returns the first matching row, and bCheckNone=false means NAME_None is not rejected up front.

Value.simple: The number the game uses for one part of a PvE result, such as money or healing. A bigger number usually means a bigger reward.
Value.technical: Native float declared with UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, EditAnywhere, meta=(AllowPrivateAccess=true)) at header line 15; constructor default 0.0f, read from row +0x10. Risk (0x162aac0) starts at RISK_VALUE_MISSION_CLEAR_VALUE (100), multiplies by TASK_CLEAR_RATE (1.5) when completed tasks >= MissionTaskIds.Num(), by CLEAR_RATE_01..03 (1.0/1.1/1.2) for PvEMissionIds.Num() 1..3, by EVALUATION_RATE_C/B/A/S (1.0/1.1/1.2/1.3) for result Rank 1..4 and by the PvEMission risk difficulty row (A..E = 1.0/1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5), then FloorToInt; extra missions and (MaxRisk > CurrentRisk || loss) force 0, and only MissionKind 1 calls it. Money (0x1628780) for an extra mission is MONEY_EXTRA_MISSION_VALUE (10000) plus on a win MONEY_EXTRA_MISSION_CLEAR_BONUS (50000), with each lookup guarded; otherwise it is max(bonus-score sum, 0) times the PvEMission money difficulty row (A..E = 1.1/1.3/1.8/3.0/4.5), TASK_CLEAR_RATE (1.3) if all tasks, BINDINGVOWS_00..03 (1.0/1.1/1.2/1.3) by count of non-None vows (0..3), and HELP (1.25) only when HelpState is 0 (another online user requested SOS). The final win/loss rate is from BindingVowsEffectDataTable effect sums, not from this table: a win adds effects to 1.0 and floors the result at 1.0; a loss adds effects to 1.0 and clamps to [0,1]; final payout is FloorToInt(Rate * Money). Experience (0x1627cb0) has the extra-mission pair 5000 + win 20000; for normal missions it starts from EVALUATION_VALUE_C/B/A/S (10/30/60/100) for Rank 1..4 (0 if unmapped), multiplies by the PvEMission experience difficulty row (A..E = 1.0/1.3/1.8/2.5/3.5), TASK_CLEAR_RATE (2.0), BINDINGVOWS_00..03 (1.0/1.1/1.15/1.3) and HELP (1.5) under the same conditions, applies the experience-specific BindingVowsEffect rate with the same win floor/loss clamp, then FloorToInt. Extra-mission point rows (0x1628170/0x1628080) are C/B/A/S = 0/5/8/12, guarded and floored; Rank 0, 0xFF (the snapshot reset/BonusRank sentinel) and any other value leave 0. Heal points (0x1628260) add CLEAR_VALUE (1) when bClear is true, TASK_CLEAR_00..03 (0/0/1/2) by completed-task count, and BINDINGVOWS_00..03 (0/1/1/2) by non-None vow count; only map lookups are guarded and the total is floored. Mode-clear helpers (0x1628e70/0x1628ac0) sum A..E as 1..5 from the PvEMission money/experience IDs over PlayedMissionIds plus the current mission; a sum of 3..15 selects BONUS_SUM_03..15 (money 1000..50000, experience 100..2000) and HEAL_POINT_BONUS_SUM_03..15 (money 50..10000, experience 50..200 per heal point), add Max(HealPoint * per-point Value, 0), and FloorToInt; sums outside 3..15 select no row and yield 0. Normal money/experience/risk helpers use the PvEMission row and BindingVowIds[Slot] without bounds checks, while extra-mission branches short-circuit before those fields are used.

notes: Export inventory: one PvECalculationDataTable object/one catalog variant, RowStruct GameDataTableRow_PvECalculation, ImportKeyField Id, 109 unique row keys and no alternate or numbered shard. All rows are accounted for by consumer families: risk base/task 2, played-rate 3, evaluation 4, difficulty 5; money task/help 2, difficulty 5, vow-count 4, mode bonus 13, mode heal bonus 13, extra 2; experience evaluation 4, difficulty 5, task/help 2, vow-count 4, mode bonus 13, mode heal bonus 13, extra 2; heal clear 1, task 4, vow-count 4; extra-mission-point evaluation 4. All exported Value entries are JSON numbers; no sentinel or negative values occur in this table.

Load/lookup chain: StartInitialLoading registers PvECalculationDataTable as a primary-asset loader name; after all loads complete, DTM::Tick resolves it through UAbramsAssetManager and AddLoadedDataTables adds only non-null UDataTable pointers to PvECalculationDataTables (DTM+0x950). StoryFindRowOutOfLine at 0x1625810 has one explicit FGameDataTableRow_PvECalculation instantiation and returns the first matching row across that cached array. No alias or second cache for this table was found in Source, Config or Plugins; the export directory and catalog also contain only this one variant.

Cross-table keys: the PvEMission export has 1,073 rows. Its 1,072 normal missions each populate all three Id_PvECalculation_* fields with matching A/B/C/D/E names (risk 78/180/270/391/153; money and experience the same distribution). PVE_EXTRA_MISSION_01 has NAME_None in all three fields, which is safe only because IsExtraMission (substring match, 0x1311f60) makes the risk, money and experience helpers return or use their extra-mission branches before reading those fields. The A..E rows are also reinterpreted as ordinal difficulties 1..5 by GMoneyMissionDifficultyMap and GExperienceMissionDifficultyMap for the whole-run bonus.

Consumer conditions and indices: result rank 1=C, 2=B, 3=A, 4=S; 0 and the 0xFF snapshot/BonusRank sentinel have no row. Risk played-rate uses the count after Enter appends the current mission, so only 1..3 are mapped. Full-task multipliers require PreviousBattleResult.Value438 >= MissionTaskIds.Num(). Vow-count rows use non-None entries of BindingVowIds[Slot] with Slot = PreviousBattleResult.Key3D8; maps cover 0..3 only. Extra-mission-point accumulation in Enter uses the result rank for the player slot and BonusRank for every other character, then clamps each point total to [0,100]; OnResultRecorded only adds the result-rank points on a win in MissionKind 1. Heal points are calculated only on a win, with bClear=true; in PvESolo all per-index results go to the player slot, otherwise to the same index. Mode-clear bonuses require MissionKind 1 and bRunEnd, use PlayedMissionIds plus the current mission, and use the player's bounded HealPointNumbers[Slot].

Outputs: risk is passed to AddPvEMaxRiskValue and the per-battle risk tally (clamped to 0..50000 downstream); money and mode-clear money go to AddUserMoney (clamped to 0..999999999) and separate tallies; experience and mode-clear experience go to AddStudioInt_828 (same clamp); result extra points go to AddExtraMissionPoint (clamped to 0 and 100); heal points are added to HealPointNumbers and the player tally. Missing rows therefore propagate as 0 through guarded branches, but unguarded row dereferences would fail rather than fall back to the constructor's 0.0f.

Evidence status: status/functions.json labels the row finder 0x1625810 and helpers 0x1628780 (money), 0x1627cb0 (experience) and 0x1628e70/0x1628ac0 (mode clear) as state behavioural, i.e. BEHAV-certified reconstructions with unmatched retail bytes. Risk 0x162aac0 and the extra-mission-point/heal-point helpers 0x1628080/0x1628170/0x1628260 are state match. Retail RVA comments and the byte-certified static label tables in GameResultLabelTables.h support the row names and conditions; no live-runtime assertion was made.

Limitations: retail Blueprint graphs, editor-only callers and a live game run were not inspected. The project guide states Blueprints contain no game logic, but exhaustive exclusion of retail asset references is not possible from the static C++ sources and exports available here; behavioural status is not byte-identical parity.

usages.detail: Resolves PvECalculationDataTable through the asset-manager loader and caches non-null tables in PvECalculationDataTables (DTM+0x950); null pointers are filtered at lines 146-154.
StoryFindRowOutOfLine walks the cached tables with bCheckNone=false; line 781 explicitly instantiates it for FGameDataTableRow_PvECalculation at retail 0x1625810.
GamePvE_CalcResultRiskValue applies base, task, played-mission, evaluation and PvEMission risk rows, then forces zero for extra missions, below-max-risk condition or a loss before flooring.
GamePvE_CalcResultMoney uses guarded extra-mission payouts or the normal bonus-score/mission/task/vow/help multipliers, then the separate BindingVowsEffect win/loss rate, and floors the result.
GamePvE_CalcResultExperience uses the four evaluation amounts, PvEMission experience difficulty, task/vow/help multipliers and the experience-specific BindingVowsEffect rate.

GamePvE_CalcExtraMissionPoint supplies the C/B/A/S points used during result Enter to roll an extra mission, with the player rank and the 0xFF BonusRank sentinel selecting different characters' ranks.
GamePvE_CalcResultExtraMissionPoint repeats the evaluation lookup with the finished battle's rank for the win/MissionKind-1 saved-point payout.
GamePvE_CalcResultHealPoint adds the clear value, completed-task count row and non-None vow-count row, with a 0 short-circuit for extra missions.
GamePvE_CalcModeClearMoney and, at line 378, GamePvE_CalcModeClearExperience map the run's PvEMission IDs to A..E ordinals 1..5, select 3..15 bonus rows and add a floored HealPoint-per-point term.
Byte-certified static label maps supply every constructed row name: evaluation/task/vow/mode-clear indices, A..E difficulty names and their ordinal values.
OnResultRecorded calls the helpers at lines 813, 820, 823, 828, 836, 850 and 853 and deposits the int32 results into risk, money, experience, extra-point, heal-point and mode-clear state/tallies.
